actions.desc: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 19 (3d8+6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Fork

actions.desc: The horned devil slams its horned head into a creature it can see within 5 feet of it. The target must make a DC 17 STR save. On a failure, the target takes 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone. On a success, the target takes half the damage and isn't knocked prone.

actions.desc: _Ranged Spell Attack:_ +7 to hit, range 150 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 20 (5d6+3) fire damage. If the target is a flammable object that isn't being worn or carried, it also catches fire.

actions.desc: The devil makes two Fork attacks and one Tail attack, or it makes three Hurl Flame attacks.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.desc: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 22 (3d10+6) piercing damage. If the target is a creature other than a Construct or Undead, it must succeed on a DC 17 CON save or lose 10 (3d6) HP at the start of each of its turns due to an infernal wound. Each time the devil hits the wounded target with this attack, the damage dealt by the wound increases by 10 (3d6). Any creature can take an action to stanch the wound with a successful DC 12 WIS (Medicine) check. The wound also closes if the target receives magical healing.
actions.desc_ru: Действие «Хвост»; тип: action. Производный машинный текст из структурированных полей записи; полный исходный текст — в поле desc (требуется перевод и редакторская вычитка).
actions.name: Tail

traits.desc: The devil is resistant to cold damage and to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. In addition, it is immune to fire damage and poison damage and to the poisoned condition.

traits.name: Devilish Resilience

traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's darkvision.

ru.description:
*Большое Исчадие (дьявол), Принципиально-злой*

- **Класс Доспеха:** 18 (природный доспех)
- **Хиты:** 178 (17к10 + 85)
- **Скорость:** 20 фт., Полёт 60 фт.

| СИЛ      | ЛОВ      | ТЕЛ      | ИНТ      | МДР      | ХАР      |
|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| 22 (+6)  | 17 (+3)  | 21 (+5)  | 12 (+1)  | 16 (+3)  | 17 (+3)  |

- **Спасброски:** Сил +10, Лов +7, Мдр +7, Хар +7
- **Сопротивление к урону:** Холод; Дробящий, Колющий и Рубящий от немагических атак, не нанесённых посеребрённым оружием
- **Иммунитет к урону:** Огонь, Яд
- **Иммунитет к состояниям:** Отравленный
- **Чувства:** тёмное зрение 120 фт.; Пассивная Внимательность 13
- **Языки:** Инфернальный, телепатия 120 фт.
- **Показатель опасности:** 11 (7 200 ОО)
ru.name: Рогатый дьявол
